title: extensions.recipe_tools
description: Whether a recipe query's own `tool:` name is registered as an MCP tool of its own. Default true: the catalogue author curates which queries declare a name, each one runs the same validated read-only Cypher run_recipe_query does, and a name another route already owns refuses the boot. Set false to serve the two fixed routes only. Boot-time: a `tool:` added or removed after boot needs a restart.
